123		}

126		p.cancelFunc = cancel

235		p.mu.Lock()
236		defer p.mu.Unlock()
237	
238		if p.closed {
239			return ErrPipelineClosed

248	// to the right.
249	func (p *Pipeline) InsertFilter(idx int, f Filter) error {
250		if f == nil {
251			return errors.New("filter must not be nil")
252		}
253	
254		p.mu.Lock()
255		defer p.mu.Unlock()
256	
257		if p.closed {
258			return ErrPipelineClosed
259		}
260	
261		if idx < 0 || idx > len(p.filters) {
262			return fmt.Errorf("index out of bounds")
263		}
264	
265		p.filters = append(p.filters[:idx], append([]Filter{f}, p.filters[idx:]...)...)
266		p.logger.Info("filter inserted", zap.String("name", f.Name()), zap.Int("position", idx))
267		return nil
268	}

270	// RemoveFilter deletes the first filter matching the provided name.
271	func (p *Pipeline) RemoveFilter(name string) error {
272		p.mu.Lock()
273		defer p.mu.Unlock()
274	
275		if p.closed {
276			return ErrPipelineClosed
277		}
278	
279		for i, f := range p.filters {
280			if f.Name() == name {
281				p.filters = append(p.filters[:i], p.filters[i+1:]...)
282				p.logger.Info("filter removed", zap.String("name", name), zap.Int("position", i))
283				return nil
284			}
285		}
286	
287		return fmt.Errorf("filter %q not found", name)
288	}

290	// ReplaceFilter swaps the filter at index with the provided one.
291	func (p *Pipeline) ReplaceFilter(idx int, f Filter) error {
292		if f == nil {
293			return errors.New("filter must not be nil")
294		}
295	
296		p.mu.Lock()
297		defer p.mu.Unlock()
298	
299		if p.closed {
300			return ErrPipelineClosed
301		}
302	
303		if idx < 0 || idx >= len(p.filters) {
304			return fmt.Errorf("index out of bounds")
305		}
306	
307		prev := p.filters[idx].Name()
308		p.filters[idx] = f
309		p.logger.Info("filter replaced", zap.Int("position", idx), zap.String("previous", prev), zap.String("new", f.Name()))
310		return nil
311	}
312	
313	// worker is the goroutine responsible for pulling events from the input
314	// channel and pushing them through the filter chain.
315	func (p *Pipeline) worker(ctx context.Context, id int) {
316		defer p.workerWG.Done()
317		log := p.logger.With(zap.Int("worker", id))
318	
319		for {
320			select {
321			case <-ctx.Done():
322				log.Debug("worker exiting")
323				return
324			case evt := <-p.input:
325				p.processEvent(ctx, log, evt)
326			}
327		}
328	}
329	
330	// processEvent executes the filter chain for a single PacketEvent.
331	func (p *Pipeline) processEvent(ctx context.Context, log *zap.Logger, evt *PacketEvent) {
332		start := time.Now()
333	
334		p.mu.RLock()
335		filtersSnapshot := make([]Filter, len(p.filters))
336		copy(filtersSnapshot, p.filters)
337		p.mu.RUnlock()
338	
339		current := evt
340		var err error
341	
342		for _, f := range filtersSnapshot {
343			current, err = f.Process(ctx, current)
344			if err != nil {
345				p.metrics.errorTotal.Inc()
346				log.Warn("filter error", zap.String("filter", f.Name()), zap.Error(err))
347				return
348			}
349			if current == nil {
350				// Event swallowed intentionally.
351				return
352			}
353		}
354	
355		// Broadcast to subscribers.
356		p.mu.RLock()
357		for _, sub := range p.subscribers {
358			select {
359			case sub <- current:
360			default:
361				// If subscriber buffer is full, drop to avoid blocking pipeline.
362				log.Debug("dropping event for slow subscriber")
363			}
364		}
365		p.mu.RUnlock()
366	
367		p.metrics.processedTotal.Inc()
368		p.metrics.processingDuration.Observe(time.Since(start).Seconds())
369	}

313	// ColorizerFilter maps source IP to a deterministic hue and paints a single

322	func (f *ColorizerFilter) Apply(ev PacketEvent, c *Canvas) error {

328		r, g, b := hsvToRGB(float64(hue), 0.9, 0.9)

331		x := int(ipHash(ev.SrcIP)+ipHash(ev.DstIP)) % c.cfg.Width
332		y := int(ipHash(ev.DstIP)+ipHash(ev.SrcIP)) % c.cfg.Height

337		c.mu.Lock()

342				if dx*dx+dy*dy > f.BrushSize*f.BrushSize {
343					continue // outside circle
344				}

346				py := y + dy

370		bounds := c.img.Bounds()
371		for y := bounds.Min.Y; y < bounds.Max.Y; y++ {
372			for x := bounds.Min.X; x < bounds.Max.X; x++ {
373				orig := c.img.RGBAAt(x, y)
374				orig.R = uint8(float64(orig.R) * (1 - intensity))
375				orig.G = uint8(float64(orig.G) * (1 - intensity))
376				orig.B = uint8(float64(orig.B) * (1 - intensity))
377				c.img.SetRGBA(x, y, orig)

405	// hsvToRGB is a lightweight HSV→RGB converter; h in [0,360).
406	func hsvToRGB(h, s, v float64) (r, g, b uint8) {
407		h = math.Mod(h, 360)
408		s = clamp(s, 0, 1)
409		v = clamp(v, 0, 1)
410	
411		c := v * s
412		x := c * (1 - math.Abs(math.Mod(h/60, 2)-1))
413		m := v - c
414	
415		var r1, g1, b1 float64
416		switch {
417		case 0 <= h && h < 60:
418			r1, g1, b1 = c, x, 0
419		case 60 <= h && h < 120:
420			r1, g1, b1 = x, c, 0
421		case 120 <= h && h < 180:
422			r1, g1, b1 = 0, c, x
423		case 180 <= h && h < 240:
424			r1, g1, b1 = 0, x, c
425		case 240 <= h && h < 300:
426			r1, g1, b1 = x, 0, c
427		default:
428			r1, g1, b1 = c, 0, x
429		}
430		r = uint8((r1 + m) * 255)
431		g = uint8((g1 + m) * 255)
432		b = uint8((b1 + m) * 255)
433		return
434	}

124	func (c *liveCapturer) Start() error {
125		c.log.Info("starting packet capturer")
126		for _, iface := range c.cfg.Interfaces {
127			handle, err := pcap.OpenLive(
128				iface,

147			}

149			c.mu.Lock()
150			c.handles[iface] = handle

174	// event-bus until Stop() is called or the pcap handle errors out.
175	func (c *liveCapturer) loop(iface string, src *gopacket.PacketSource) {
176		defer c.wg.Done()
177		c.log.Debug("capture loop started", zap.String("iface", iface))
178	
179		for {
180			select {
181			case <-c.shutdown:
182				return
183			case pkt, ok := <-src.Packets():
184				if !ok {
185					c.log.Warn("packet channel closed unexpectedly", zap.String("iface", iface))

193	func (c *liveCapturer) processPacket(iface string, pkt gopacket.Packet) {
194		evt := PacketEvent{
195			Timestamp: pkt.Metadata().Timestamp,
196			Interface: iface,
197			Length:    len(pkt.Data()),
198			Raw:       pkt,
199		}
200	
201		// Extract addresses/protocol
202		if eth := pkt.Layer(layers.LayerTypeEthernet); eth != nil {
203			frame := eth.(*layers.Ethernet)
204			evt.SrcMAC = frame.SrcMAC.String()
205			evt.DstMAC = frame.DstMAC.String()
206		}
207		if ipv4 := pkt.Layer(layers.LayerTypeIPv4); ipv4 != nil {
208			ip := ipv4.(*layers.IPv4)
209			evt.SrcIP = ip.SrcIP.String()
210			evt.DstIP = ip.DstIP.String()
211			evt.Protocol = ip.Protocol.String()
212		} else if ipv6 := pkt.Layer(layers.LayerTypeIPv6); ipv6 != nil {
213			ip := ipv6.(*layers.IPv6)
214			evt.SrcIP = ip.SrcIP.String()
215			evt.DstIP = ip.DstIP.String()
216			evt.Protocol = ip.NextHeader.String()
217		}
218	
219		// Entropy (cheap approximation)
220		evt.PayloadEntropy = computeEntropy(pkt.ApplicationLayer())
221	
222		// Metrics
223		c.metrics.packetsCaptured.WithLabelValues(iface).Inc()
224		c.metrics.bytesCaptured.WithLabelValues(iface).Add(float64(evt.Length))
225	
226		// Publish
227		if err := c.bus.Publish(TopicPackets, evt); err != nil {
228			c.metrics.captureErrors.Inc()
229			c.log.Error("unable to publish packet event", zap.Error(err))
230		}

233	// computeEntropy delivers a value in range [0,8] (bits of entropy per
234	// byte) by hashing and folding the payload.  It intentionally avoids
235	// expensive math so it can run per-packet at high throughput.
236	func computeEntropy(layer gopacket.ApplicationLayer) float64 {
237		if layer == nil {
238			return 0
239		}
240		payload := layer.Payload()
241		if len(payload) == 0 {
242			return 0
243		}
244		// Use SHA-1 as pseudo-randomiser then fold into 64 bits.
245		sum := sha1.Sum(payload)
246		val := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(sum[:8])
247		popcnt := bitsInUint64(val)
248		entropy := float64(popcnt) / 64 * 8 // scale to 0..8
249		return entropy
250	}
251	
252	func bitsInUint64(v uint64) int {
253		// Kernighan’s popcount
254		cnt := 0
255		for v != 0 {
256			v &= v - 1
257			cnt++
258		}
259		return cnt
260	}
